actions.name: Pack Warden rations
actions.description: Pay the Ashgate stores to seal four route-ready provision packs.
actions.tradeoff: More travel flexibility now, but six fewer ashmarks for cargo.

actions.name: Join the cistern queue
actions.description: Wait with the wellkeepers to learn which pumps are failing.
actions.tradeoff: Gain a durable pump-failure lead and strengthen the local reserve by one, but spend a day.
actions.result: The queue maps the failing pumps and organizes a protected reserve. Brine Cross resilience rises by one and the pump-failure lead is recorded.
actions.unavailable_reason: Available when Thin Wells begins at crisis stage 1.

actions.name: Sell a sealed crate to the Cinder Rider broker
actions.description: A Cinder Rider broker offers 82 ashmarks for one sealed arms crate.
actions.tradeoff: Raises arms escalation to the first inspection threshold and costs standing with both road networks.

actions.name: Fund a public manifest audit
actions.description: Pay neutral clerks to reconcile sealed-cargo manifests and publish the discrepancies.
actions.tradeoff: Costs money, one day, and a visit slot to reduce arms pressure by one stage.

actions.name: Reserve the repair bench

route_condition.label: Cinderford road repaired
route_condition.description: Reserved foundry time reinforces the Toll Road approach through Cinderford.

actions.description: Set aside foundry time for caravan repairs.
actions.tradeoff: Lower Toll Road exposure by three points in exchange for fourteen ashmarks and one day.
actions.result: The repair crew braces the Cinderford approach. Toll Road exposure falls by three points and the public ledger records the work.

actions.name: Buy a route rumor

route_condition.label: Water cache marked
route_condition.description: A paid Hollow Market report marks a dependable water cache and narrows the exposed crossing.

actions.description: Pay a broker for a recent route report of uncertain quality.
actions.tradeoff: Lower Dry Cut exposure by five points, but the report costs six ashmarks and never guarantees safety.
actions.result: The broker marks a dependable water cache. Dry Cut exposure falls by five points and the route lead is recorded.

actions.name: Open the supply shelter
actions.description: Reserve delivered goods for a protected local supply point.
actions.tradeoff: Spend one day to add one local resilience and one Free Caravan standing after completing water relief.
actions.result: The relief stores open as a protected public shelter. Reedwatch resilience and Free Caravan standing each rise by one.
actions.unavailable_reason: Requires completed Reedwatch Water Relief during crisis stage 1 or later.

actions.name: Fuel the Commons boilers
actions.description: Commit two charcoal to the public boiling fires and pump crews.
actions.tradeoff: Give up an immediate charcoal sale to strengthen the Commons, Reedwatch, and Free Caravan standing.
actions.result: Two charcoal fuel the public boilers. Reedwatch resilience, Free Caravan standing, and Commons support each rise by one.
actions.unavailable_reason: Available after the Well Commons organizes in Reedwatch.

actions.name: Publish the Commons ledger

route_condition.label: Commons water stations
route_condition.description: Published ration stops make the Dry Cut easier to cross.

actions.description: Fund a public ration ledger and mark Commons water stations on the Dry Cut.
actions.tradeoff: Spend eight ashmarks, one day, and one visit slot for public route knowledge and stronger Commons influence.
actions.result: The ration ledger is public. Dry Cut exposure falls by three points; Free Caravan standing and Commons support each rise by one.
actions.unavailable_reason: Available after the Well Commons organizes in Reedwatch.

actions.name: Buy a Warden cistern permit
actions.description: Use a Warden permit to buy around the Commons ration queue.
actions.tradeoff: Gain official access and Warden standing, but reduce Commons support; ordinary market trade remains available.
actions.result: The permit bypasses the ration queue. Warden standing rises by one and Commons support falls by one without closing the market.
actions.unavailable_reason: Available after the Well Commons organizes in Reedwatch.

records.name: Reedwatch Water Relief
records.description: Carry four sealed water units from Ashgate to Reedwatch before the public reserve is rationed.
records.tradeoff: A guaranteed premium and visible relief, but four hold spaces and a short deadline are committed.
records.decision_summary: Guaranteed relief premium; commits four hold spaces and a short deadline.
records.recovery_summary: Late cargo remains sellable; the cash penalty is capped.
records.failure_recovery: Late cargo remains yours to sell, and the penalty never takes more ashmarks than you hold.

records.name: Brine Cross Medicine Escort
records.description: Escort two registered medicine cases through the Toll Road inspection chain to Brine Cross.
records.tradeoff: A modest guaranteed margin and Warden standing, but the named manifest exposes the caravan to official scrutiny and commits two hold spaces.
records.decision_summary: Guaranteed margin and Warden access; accepts a named manifest and official scrutiny.
records.recovery_summary: Late medicine remains sellable; money and standing losses are bounded.
records.failure_recovery: Late medicine remains yours to sell; the office charges at most six ashmarks and withdraws one Warden standing.

records.offered_summary: Reedwatch's wellkeepers are asking Ashgate caravans for a fast water delivery.
records.expired_summary: The public relief window closed before the caravan committed. Reedwatch's households organized their own exchange.

failure_response.name: The Well Commons
failure_response.material_basis: Shared cistern labor, household ration tallies, and public boiling fires.
failure_response.legitimacy_claim: Reedwatch residents kept water moving when official relief did not arrive.
failure_response.trade_footprint: The Commons stabilizes water prices and buys charcoal for boiling and pump work.

opportunity.title: Commons Charcoal Exchange
opportunity.summary: Reedwatch's public boiling fires now pay a durable premium for ordinary charcoal deliveries. No contract is required.

records.name: Nara Vey
records.personality: Patient with evidence, impatient with official certainty.
records.limitation: Nara's report covers routes leaving the current settlement and becomes stale after the day advances.
records.hook: A same-day assignment adds scout confidence and a route-specific warning without removing uncertainty.

route_notes.old_road: Fresh wheel cuts leave room for improvised blocks and unmarked riders.
route_notes.toll_road: The road surface is sound; queues, chalk marks, and inspections remain the uncertainty.
route_notes.dry_cut: The markers are thin and the salt wind can erase a safe-looking line within hours.

records.name: Jorun Pale
records.personality: Dry, exacting, and unwilling to call an overloaded wagon brave.
records.limitation: Jorun's packing plan covers routes leaving the current settlement and expires after the day advances.
records.hook: A same-day assignment reduces the selected route's provision use by one, never below one, and states the saving before departure.

route_notes.old_road: Jorun shifts the dense crates over the rear axle and seals one ration pack for later.
route_notes.toll_road: Jorun matches the manifest order to the gate queue and avoids opening a second ration pack.
route_notes.dry_cut: Jorun portions the water stops precisely; the cut still consumes at least one provision.

records.name: Tess Oryn
records.personality: Warm in public, exact about who benefits from every stamped exception.
records.limitation: Tess opens negotiation responses only while assigned; using them may create visible political costs.
records.hook: Assignment exposes a ledger challenge during Gatekeeper's Chalk without making the route automatically safe.

route_notes.old_road: Tess names the brokers who profit when official traffic abandons the road.
route_notes.toll_road: Tess recognizes which seal numbers force a clerk to defend the posted rate.
route_notes.dry_cut: Tess knows who sells passage claims, but not whether the markers still exist.

wardens.name: Ash Wardens
wardens.effect: Recognized carriers pay 3 fewer ashmarks on the Toll Road.
wardens.tradeoff: The discount comes with a named manifest and greater official visibility.

caravans.name: Free Caravans
caravans.effect: Known road-sharers pay 2 fewer ashmarks in Old Road guide and camp fees.
caravans.tradeoff: The informal discount does not reduce the route's exposed cargo risk.

records.title: The Gatekeeper's Chalk
records.setup: An Ash Warden clerk marks the caravan wheels with fresh chalk and disputes the posted passage rate.
records.stakes: Pay for certainty, spend time and provisions on an exposed detour, or wait for a stamped review.

choices.label: Pay 6 ashmarks
choices.outcome: The clerk clears the chalk and records the caravan's passage.

choices.label: Take the dust detour
choices.outcome: The caravan avoids the gate but spends another day and provision on exposed ground.

choices.label: Wait for stamped review
choices.outcome: The office confirms the original fare after a full day of delay.

choices.label: Let Tess challenge the ledger
choices.outcome: Tess forces the clerk to expose a pattern of invented tolls, but the Wardens record the challenge.

records.title: The Span at Cinderford
records.setup: A Cinderford bridge crew has shored up a failed support and recognizes repair stock in the caravan.
records.stakes: Trade the material for immediate margin, reserve it for a safer public span, carry the measurements onward, or turn back with the load intact.

choices.label: Sell 2 repair materials for 30 ashmarks
choices.outcome: The crew buys the stock for private repair work; the public span remains exposed.

choices.label: Reserve 2 materials for the public span

route_condition.label: Cinderford span patched
route_condition.description: Reserved repair stock has lowered the chance of a load failure at the Cinderford span.

choices.outcome: The crew bolts the reserved stock into the public support and reopens a steadier crossing.

choices.label: Carry the repair measurements onward

route_condition.label: Cinderford span surveyed
route_condition.description: Delivered measurements let the road crews mark a safer load line across the span.

choices.outcome: The next road crew receives exact measurements and marks a safer load line.

choices.label: Turn back with the cargo intact
choices.outcome: The caravan reverses before the failed support and preserves the full load.

records.title: The Last Clean Barrel
records.setup: The destination's public water queue is down to its last sealed barrel when the caravan reaches the ration line.
records.stakes: Take the scarcity premium, strengthen the public queue, honor a relief commitment, or keep the load for an ordinary market sale.

choices.label: Sell 2 water at the emergency premium
choices.outcome: Private buyers take the sealed barrels at the posted emergency premium.

choices.label: Share 2 water through the public queue
choices.outcome: The queue stewards ration both barrels and add the caravan's name to the public reserve ledger.

choices.label: Keep the load for the relief commitment
choices.outcome: The queue stands aside while the caravan reports directly to the named contract sponsor.

choices.label: Keep the barrels sealed for the market
choices.outcome: The caravan keeps control of the load and enters the ordinary market.

records.title: Three Riders, No Banner
records.setup: Three unmarked riders match the caravan's pace and offer to guarantee the exposed crossing for a price.
records.stakes: Buy certainty, risk one disclosed cargo unit, trade medicine for passage, or wait long enough to identify their sponsor mark.

choices.label: Pay 10 ashmarks for escort
choices.outcome: The riders form a close screen around the caravan until the destination markers appear.

choices.label: Refuse and cross alone
choices.outcome: The caravan keeps its money and accepts the disclosed exposed-unit risk.

choices.label: Trade 1 medicine for passage
choices.outcome: One rider pockets the sealed medicine and leads the caravan through a screened cut.

choices.label: Wait and read the riders' tracks
choices.outcome: At dusk the riders leave; their tack has pressed a repeated sponsor mark into the ash.

produces.grain: Reserve granaries keep ordinary grain available.
produces.water: Licensed cistern releases keep water below frontier prices.
produces.charcoal: Regulated fuel stores maintain a steady charcoal supply.
produces.sealed_arms_crate: Licensed depots hold sealed equipment under named manifests.

consumes.scrap: Gate repairs and wagon yards keep local scrap demand active.
consumes.cloth: Officials and passing caravans pay for durable dyed cloth.

trade_profile.ordinary_trade_note: A stable departure market: modest sources, regulated access, and clear outward spreads.

produces.water: Working brine wells keep ordinary water plentiful before the crisis deepens.

consumes.grain: Well crews consume imported grain through every season.
consumes.scrap: Cistern pumps absorb repair scrap as fast as it arrives.
consumes.medicine: Salt sores and failing pumps keep medicine demand high.

trade_profile.ordinary_trade_note: Water leaves cheaply; food, repair stock, and medicine return at a premium.

produces.scrap: Salvage yards sort usable scrap beside the furnaces.
produces.charcoal: Local kilns make charcoal the town's dependable export.

consumes.grain: Foundry shifts keep staple demand high.
consumes.water: Furnaces and workers consume more water than the town can draw.
consumes.cloth: Heat, sparks, and hard labor create steady demand for replacement cloth.
consumes.sealed_arms_crate: Competing foundry patrons seek controlled equipment and weapon stock.

trade_profile.ordinary_trade_note: Heavy industry turns cheap material exports into recurring demand for food, water, and cloth.

produces.grain: Independent growers sell small grain lots without Warden tariffs.
produces.medicine: Private apothecaries keep compact medicine bundles moving.
produces.cloth: Reed weavers and dyers make cloth the bazaar's signature export.

consumes.water: Crowded stalls and uncertain wells keep water demand volatile.
consumes.charcoal: Cooking fires and dye works consume imported charcoal.
consumes.sealed_arms_crate: Unlicensed brokers pay for restricted crates despite the political exposure.

trade_profile.ordinary_trade_note: Low formal costs reward information, timing, and tolerance for volatile buyers.

produces.grain: Reed plots and dry fields make grain the settlement's reliable outbound cargo.
produces.cloth: Reed fiber and household looms keep simple cloth available.

consumes.water: Frontier wells run low, so local demand is high for every sealed water load.
consumes.scrap: Wells, roofs, and road barriers create recurring repair demand.
consumes.medicine: Distance from clinics keeps medicine scarce and valuable.

trade_profile.ordinary_trade_note: Frontier shortages pay well, while local grain and cloth make the return journey viable.

arms_trade.warning: This sale raises arms escalation to a visible Warden inspection threshold.
arms_trade.recovery: Public route support and verified warning-sharing will provide later de-escalation paths.

stages.label: Ordinary pressure
stages.objective: Compare markets and prepare a first route.

stages.label: Thin wells
stages.objective: Move water or medicine before local reserves harden.

old_road.description: Thin wells draw more opportunists to the unguarded crossings.

stages.label: Empty reservoir
stages.objective: Build resilience while routes and factions compete for supply.

old_road.description: Water convoys crowd the exposed road and make ambushes easier.

toll_road.description: Emergency inspections add two ashmarks to the regulated corridor.

stages.label: Settlement decision
stages.objective: Secure a durable relief outcome without letting arms pressure dominate the roads.

old_road.description: The final water rush leaves the open road at its most exposed.

toll_road.description: Cistern controls add four ashmarks to every official passage.

endings.title: Open Routes, Shared Wells
endings.summary: Reedwatch's public reserve holds, relief caravans retain access, and the basin enters the next season without armed traffic controlling the roads. The caravan chose accountable supply over a single controlling buyer.

endings.title: Order at the Cistern
endings.summary: Public water reserves remain uneven, but the Ash Wardens secure the cistern roads under permits. Arms traffic stays contained; the caravan chose predictable access and regulated margins over an open network.

endings.title: No Road Owns the Sky
endings.summary: Shared water reaches exposed settlements through independent caravans, keeping access open without Warden permits. Arms traffic stays contained; the caravan chose volatile margins, public information, and risk shared across the road network.

endings.title: The Best Margin
endings.summary: The caravan becomes the basin's indispensable broker while Reedwatch's public reserve remains fragile. Access follows purchasing power, arms traffic stays contained, and the player chose concentrated profit over shared recovery.

old_road.name: Old Road
old_road.description: Cheap, exposed, and watched by opportunists.

toll_road.name: Toll Road
toll_road.description: Expensive but maintained by the Ash Wardens.

dry_cut.name: Dry Cut
dry_cut.description: Fast on the map, punishing on provisions.
